subtopics.title: AI domains
subtopics.teaching: Master AI domains within AI Concepts for National AI Challenge. Build precise concepts and terminology first, then connect them to examples, interpretation and competition-style reasoning. Students should distinguish evidence from assumption, compare alternatives, and justify conclusions rather than relying on memorised associations.
subtopics.worked_example: Worked example: analyse a representative AI domains question, identify the decisive concept or textual/evidential clue, reason through the alternatives, and verify the conclusion.
subtopics.pitfall: Common pitfall: confusing a related concept, author, text, period, technology or interpretation with the exact item requested by the question.
subtopics.mastery: Mastery: solve an unfamiliar AI domains task independently, explain the decisive evidence or principle, reject a plausible distractor, and verify the conclusion.
